name: Haus Christine
beschreibung: Haus Christine is an inn in Tannheim in the Tannheimer Tal. The business is run as a family business. The house offers overnight accommodation and meals. The kitchen serves traditional Tiroler dishes with regional ingredients. The rooms are functional and equipped with shower and WC. The inn is located quietly yet centrally in the village. From here, hikes in the Tannheimer Tal can be undertaken. In winter, guests have access to cross-country ski trails and ski slopes.
